about: Interview question angles for doctypes.py (round 4, 2026-10-10), written by Claude. 'personal': two per frame, each a question that any personal characteristic or pastime answers naturally in the first person; no 'what would X say about you' angles, no work, background, family, qualities, interests, habits or time-use, and none of the readout cues. 'work': one per frame, for the question he answers himself.
